subject: E-1359: totals mismatch on Linux
body:
Hello support team. We run SyncVault 4.2.2 on Fedora 41. Starting this morning, the moment I export the report a dialog reads 'E-1359: totals do not match source'.

Every line differs by a cent or two, which looks like rounding. A rounding fix is listed in the newest version's release notes.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Thanks, Kenji Sato (Ferro & Sons)
